newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Toyota in 4.0 bln peso Manila investment.
newsitem.headline: Toyota in 4.0 bln peso Manila investment.

text.p: Toyota Motor Philippines Corp (TMPC), part of Japan's Toyota Motor Corp, will complete a 4.0 billion peso investment by the first quarter of 1997 to expand its facilities, TMPC senior vice president Florencio Jurado said on Friday.

Some 2.5 billion pesos will be invested in a new plant in Laguna, south of Manila, which will increase its production capacity of passenger cars by 25,000 units to 65,000. This plant would be fully operational in January, Florencio said.
"We are now on trial production," he said.
Another 1.5 billion pesos will go expand its transmission plant and a new parts shop in the same complex in Laguna.

The transmission system and a new product, called the constant velocity joint, will be produced for the export market, he said. The constant velocity joint is used to stabilise the vibration motion between the axle and transmission.
The transmission plant, which will come onstream in January, will raise capacity by at least 50,000 units from the current level of 200,000 units, he said.
To date, Toyota has invested 10 billion pesos in the Philippines since it started operations in 1988, Jurado said.
